a.lede: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.
a.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: An internal letter was sent to Nvidia's board and top executives warning that "irreplaceable talent" could leave if Jensen Huang isn't reinstated as CEO.
b.title: Nvidia employee warns of 'irreplaceable' talent exodus if Jensen Huang not reinstated
